final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) as col3_avg_remaingb, AVG(CAST(sp.proccpu AS REAL) - CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL)) as col4_avg_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(col3_avg_remaingb) as col1_avg_of_avg_remaingb FROM step1) SELECT step1.zoneref, step1.insurstat, step1.col3_avg_remaingb, step1.col4_avg_cpu_gpu_diff, step1.col3_avg_remaingb / step2.col1_avg_of_avg_remaingb as col5_division FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.col1_avg_of_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL ORDER BY col5_division DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
